TIME_SPEED_HINT: Speed {speed}: {days} days per second (keys 1–5, or + and − on the number pad)
AMOUNT_HINT: t = tonnes, kt = thousand tonnes, Mt = million tonnes. MWh = megawatt-hours, GWh = thousand MWh, TWh = million MWh.
COUNTRY_PANEL_GDP_TOOLTIP: Gross domestic product: the value of everything the country produces in a year, in US dollars
COUNTRY_PANEL_SOURCE: GDP: real-world figures for {year} (IMF, World Bank). Population: simulated, starting from the real-world figures for {year} (World Bank)
COUNTRY_SELECTION_HINT: Click a country on the map, search for one, or pick one below.
COUNTRY_SELECTION_PLAY_NOTE: The game starts paused. Your choice can't be changed later in this game.
COUNTRY_SCREEN_INTEREST_GROUPS_HINT: Each group's clout as a slice of the pie, with its approval of the government.
COUNTRY_SCREEN_NATIONAL_MODIFIERS_NONE: None yet. They arrive with the systems that put lasting effects on a country.
COUNTRY_SCREEN_LAWS_HINT: Click a law to open the Laws screen.
COUNTRY_SCREEN_CABINET_HINT: Ministers come from interest groups and give bonuses in their area.
COUNTRY_SCREEN_PUBLIC_OPINION_HINT: How the population is split between the four stances toward the object.
COUNTRY_SCREEN_INTEL_NOTE: With little intel, hidden values show as “?”.
MAP_HINT: Click a province or sea zone for its details. Wheel or +/-: zoom. Drag, WASD, arrow keys or the window's edge: move (Shift: faster). Q/E or middle mouse button: turn.
MAP_HINT_TOUCH: Tap a province or sea zone for its details. Drag with one finger to move, pinch with two to zoom.
MAP_RESET_VIEW_HINT: Show the whole world, north up (Home key)
MAP_TOOLTIP_PROVINCE_INDUSTRY: {workers} people at work in {levels} building levels
ERROR_SIM_DATA_INVALID: The game's data files contain a mistake, so the simulation could not start.
ERROR_SIM_CRASHED: The simulation stopped because of an unexpected error.
ERROR_DEBUG_SCENARIO_UNKNOWN: There is no debug scenario with that name.
GALLERY_INTRO: Every 3D model of the game, made by code from data/models.json. Placeholders: they start simple and get better later.
GALLERY_HINT: Drag to turn, mouse wheel or pinch to zoom.
GALLERY_HINT_ROWS: Each model is a block of three rows, one per detail level: icon (far away), simple, detailed (close up). Left to right: its seeded variants. Every model is scaled to the same size (height, or width for wide ones); the list gives the real sizes.
ERROR_RENDERER_FAILED: The 3D view could not start. Your browser or graphics driver may not support WebGL 2.
ERROR_MAP_FAILED: The world map could not be loaded.
COMMAND_UNKNOWN: The simulation does not know the command "{type}".
COMMAND_UNKNOWN_PROVINCE: There is no province with the id "{province}".
COMMAND_UNKNOWN_COUNTRY: There is no country with the id "{country}".
COMMAND_UNKNOWN_BUILDING: There is no building with the id "{building}".
COMMAND_PLAYER_COUNTRY_LOCKED: The country can only be chosen before the campaign starts.
SAVE_ERROR_NOT_A_SAVE: This file is not a Terra Scutum save.
SAVE_ERROR_CORRUPT: This save is damaged and cannot be loaded.
SAVE_ERROR_DIFFERENT_MAP: This save was made on a different version of the world map and cannot be loaded.
SAVE_ERROR_NEWER_VERSION: This save was made with a newer version of the game (save format {saveVersion}; this game reads up to {gameVersion}).
SAVE_ERROR_TOO_OLD: This save is too old to load (save format {saveVersion}; this game uses {gameVersion}).
TOP_BAR_FLAG_HINT: Your country. Click to open its Government view.
TOP_BAR_TREASURY_HINT: Money in the treasury, and in brackets the balance per week. Opens the budget.
TOP_BAR_POLITICAL_CAPITAL_HINT: Spent on laws and reforms. Opens the government screen.
TOP_BAR_INFLUENCE_HINT: Spent to sway public opinion. Opens public opinion.
TOP_BAR_LEGITIMACY_HINT: How accepted the government is. Opens the government screen.
TOP_BAR_STABILITY_HINT: How calm the country is. Opens population and pops.
TOP_BAR_MANPOWER_HINT: People available to serve in the army. Opens armies and fronts.
TOP_BAR_PILOTS_HINT: Trained pilots ready for mechs and aircraft. Opens the unit roster.
TOP_BAR_SWARM_CONTROL_HINT: How much of the world the Swarm holds. Opens Swarm intel.
TOP_BAR_ARRIVAL_HINT: Time left until Object Alpha arrives (Phase 0). Opens the journal.
ALERT_HINT: Click to go there · right-click to dismiss
SCREEN_EMPTY: This screen is empty for now. It fills in when its feature is built.
POPULATION_DEPENDENTS_HINT: Children, the elderly and others who don't work. They need food and goods, but have no job.
POPULATION_STANDARD_OF_LIVING_HINT: From 0 to 100: how many of their needs people can afford. Basic needs come first (up to {basic}), then everyday needs (up to {everyday}), then luxuries (up to 100).
POPULATION_WAGE_HINT: What one worker earns in a year, in US dollars. It also feeds the worker's dependents.
POPULATION_PLACEHOLDER_NOTE: Jobs come from buildings and, for the rest of the economy, from a stand-in that keeps pace with the workforce. Wages come from each country's real GDP and prices from how rich it is. The building catalog (F85) and markets (F65) will replace these stand-ins.
BUILDINGS_OUTPUT_HINT: How much of its full output a building makes today. Missing workers, electricity or inputs lower it.
BUILDINGS_RECIPE_HINT: At full output, level {level}: makes {makes} a day; uses {uses} a day; {jobs} workers.
BUILDINGS_LIMIT_DEMAND: No more electricity is needed today.
BUILDINGS_TEST_NOTE: Change levels by hand to try things out. Real construction comes with F12 (M3).
BUILDINGS_SCREEN_TYPES_HINT: Click a building to see where it stands.
BUILDINGS_SCREEN_NONE: {country} has no buildings yet. Its people work in the rest of the economy until the building catalog (F85) gives every country its real buildings.
BUILDINGS_PLACEHOLDER_NOTE: These are six example buildings, sized to each country's economy. The full building catalog and each country's real starting buildings come with F85, prices and profits with F65, construction with F12.
STOCKPILE_HINT: What your buildings make goes into the national stockpile; what they use comes out of it. It keeps at most {days} days' worth; the rest is lost until there are markets (F65).
STOCKPILE_TEST_FILL_HINT: Tops the stockpile up to {days} days of what your buildings use, like emergency imports. A test tool: trade comes with F19 (M4).
PANEL_BACK_HINT: Back to the panel you came from
SETTINGS_HINT: Message settings, alerts, and facts about this build
SETTINGS_MESSAGES_HINT: Choose how each kind of message is shown. Your browser remembers these settings.
SETTINGS_MESSAGES_MORE: More kinds of message arrive with the features that cause them (events, news, wars…).
SETTINGS_ALERTS_HINT: Turn off the alerts you don't want in the alerts row under the top bar. Your browser remembers these settings.
SETTINGS_ABOUT_HINT: Technical facts about this version of the game, useful in bug reports.
CREDITS_MAP: Borders, coasts and rivers: made with Natural Earth (public domain).
CREDITS_ELEVATION: Terrain heights: Terrain Tiles (Mapzen, hosted as Amazon open data). GMTED2010 terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey; ETOPO1 terrain data by the U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.
CREDITS_LAND_COVER: Land cover: © ESA WorldCover project 2021 / contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by the ESA WorldCover consortium. Licensed under CC BY 4.0; reduced to the game's terrain tiles.
CREDITS_STATISTICS: Starting population and economy: World Bank (World Development Indicators) and International Monetary Fund (World Economic Outlook).
CREDITS_POPULATION: Where people live: Kontur Population, Global Population Density for 400m H3 Hexagons, © Kontur. Licensed under CC BY 4.0; reduced to the people counted in each province.
MESSAGE_LOG_HINT: Every message so far, newest first
DEMO_OWNER_CHANGE: Hand a province to a neighbor
DEMO_OWNER_CHANGE_HINT: Gives a random border province to the neighboring country, which sends a real "province changed hands" message
DEMO_ALERT_TEXT: [Sample] A made-up alert for trying the alerts row.
DEMO_TOAST_TEXT: Small messages appear here and fade after a few seconds. Click one to go to its place.
DEMO_POPUP_TEXT: Important messages open a window like this one. Each message type can be set to pop up, show as a toast, go to the log only, or be off.
STRESS_LOADING: Putting the late-game load on the map…
STRESS_LOAD: On the map: {buildings} buildings, {units} units, {bugs} bugs in a battle, {lines} infrastructure lines, {particles} rain, smoke and fire particles, {clouds} clouds, laser beams
STRESS_BUDGETS: Goals: {strategic} FPS with the whole world in view, {close} FPS up close and at the battle.
STRESS_COPIED: Copied: paste them in the chat
STRESS_PART_HINT: Show or hide this part of the load, to see what it costs
